topic: Roof Light Lamp Brightness Control Commands for Interior Lighting Subsystem
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or configuration setting for controlling the brightness and breathing rate of the roof light lamp.

column_semantics.Input: The source of the command (e.g., LIN bus, RHZCU module).
column_semantics.LIN: Command sent via the LIN communication protocol.
column_semantics.RHZCU: Command sent from the Right Hand Zone Control Unit.
column_semantics.RoofAmbtLampA_LH: Command sent to the Left Hand Roof Ambient Lamp.
column_semantics.RHZCU_LIN5: Specific LIN channel used by RHZCU.

core_entities.name: RoofLHALampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Brightness control command for the roof light lamp.

core_entities.name: RoofLHALampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Breathing rate control command for the roof light lamp.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Right Hand Zone Control Unit, responsible for sending commands to the roof light lamp.

core_entities.name: RoofAmbtLampA_LH
core_entities.description: Left Hand Roof Ambient Lamp, the target device for the brightness and breathing commands.

core_conditions.name: Brightness Level
core_conditions.description: Defined as a percentage from 0% to 100%, with 0x00 indicating no request and 0x64-0xFF reserved.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate
core_conditions.description: Defined by hexadecimal values from 0x0 to 0xF, each corresponding to a specific rate in seconds.

core_outputs.name: Code Value
core_outputs.description: The hexadecimal code representing the specific brightness level or breathing rate.

core_outputs.name: Period
core_outputs.description: The time interval for the breathing pattern, ranging from 500ms to 12s.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate0
core_timing_constraints.description: Indicates that no request is made for a specific breathing rate.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate1 - Rate15
core_timing_constraints.description: Defines the available breathing rates in seconds.

engineering_interpretation: This table specifies the command codes and parameters for controlling the brightness and breathing rate of the roof light lamp within the interior lighting subsystem. It defines how different controllers can send commands via LIN to adjust the lamp's behavior, including its intensity and flashing pattern.
